wait-seasons.label: Seasons RCB played before their first title
wait-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: matches (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026) + CricField points-tables.json (league stage)
wait-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, m.winner_id IN (2,15) won FROM matches m WHERE m.date = (SELECT MAX(x.date) FROM matches x WHERE x.season_id = m.season_id) AND (m.team1_id IN (2,15) OR m.team2_id IN (2,15))

validation.method: points-table league wins never exceed warehouse wins (which add playoffs); playoff result set exactly for top-four finishes

losing-seasons.label: Seasons with a win rate below 50%, 2008–2024
losing-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: matches (Cricsheet, IPL 2008–2026) + CricField points-tables.json (league stage)
losing-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (2,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (2,15) OR m.team2_id IN (2,15)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
